category: premium-account reseller (Indian-registered: INR storefront with an explicit domestic payment stack)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. The page sells 'Real-Debrid 30 Days Premium Account' and states delivery rather than price: 'Vouchers codes are automatically delivered to customers email account INSTANTLY'. No price was present in the rendered page.
free_tier.notes: The price sits behind the cart; the record is kept for the payment stack, which is the best-documented Indian rail found.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; Real-Debrid's own cap applies

interface_detail: Web store with an automated voucher e-mail; the buyer redeems the voucher on Real-Debrid and then uses Real-Debrid's API.
tooling: Real-Debrid's API and the usual clients; the reseller contributes only the payment leg.
chaining: The Indian payment adapter with the widest rail list: it converts Indian cards, net banking, NEFT and even cash deposit into a Real-Debrid voucher. That makes it the fallback when a card is refused abroad and a local wallet is not enough.

limits.value: voucher redemption on the provider; 30-day term

limits_note: The vendor states it does not auto-debit: 'we do not auto debit/charge your Credit Card or Debit Card, for each renewal you have to make fresh payment'.
binding_note: No technical constraint at the reseller; Real-Debrid's quotas bind after redemption.

identity_cost.detail: Two gateways: an Indian one that processes 'Credit Cards (Visa MasterCard Diners Club), Debit Cards (52 Indian Banks), Net Banking (15 Banks) & Cash Cards (Itz) all in Indian Rupees', and an international one for 'US Dollars/EURO/YEN/INR'. Offline rails: 'Cash deposit, NEFT, Cheque/DD, Offline Net Banking (ICICI, SBI, HDFC) & Western Union'. A card works from either side of the border.

reliability_note: An old-style reseller page (products still listed as FileSonic, Megaupload, Duckload) whose stock and provider relationships are stale; the payment plumbing is documented far better than the catalogue is maintained.
confidence_note: Payment rails read verbatim today. The price and stock state were not rendered, so this record proves access rather than cost; a cart test would supply the number.

evidence.proved: 'We have integrated secured Indian payment gateway & process Credit Cards (Visa MasterCard Diners Club), Debit Cards (52 Indian Banks) Net Banking (15 Banks) & Cash Cards (Itz) all in Indian Rupees'
'We support offline payments by Cash deposit, NEFT, Cheque/DD, Offline Net Banking (ICICI, SBI,HDFC) & Western Union'; 'we do not auto debit/charge your Credit Card or Debit Card'
'We are registered company in India & we are authorised resellers/distributors'; automated voucher delivery by email

notes: Recorded for the payment stack, not the price. It is the counter-example to every other market: an Indian reseller that exposes both a domestic and an international gateway, so neither a local buyer without an international card nor a foreign buyer is locked out. Abandonment condition: the checkout is found to be dead.

extras.local_gateway: Indian cards, 52 banks debit, 15 banks net banking, Itz cash cards, INR
extras.international_gateway: Amex, Carte Bleue, Visa, Discover, Diners, Maestro, MasterCard, JCB, Solo; USD/EUR/JPY/INR
extras.offline: cash deposit, NEFT, cheque/DD, Western Union
